# DiwaliBoost

> Beautiful, high-converting Diwali sale pages and mobile product showcases for Indian small businesses (sweet shops, bakeries, and local retailers) with direct WhatsApp enquiries.

## Overview
- **Name**: DiwaliBoost
- **Location**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 7062182162
- **Operating Model**: Productised, manual web design service. Fast static deployment, zero server databases, zero cart complexity, 100% WhatsApp enquiry handoff.
- **Target Audience**: Sweet shops, bakeries, dry fruit merchants, and local retailers in Jaipur and across India promoting festive Diwali offers.

## Packages and Pricing (One-Time)
- **Starter (₹499)**:
  - Up to 6 products with WhatsApp enquiries
  - Mobile-friendly responsive template page
  - Custom logo, colours & contact details
  - Page title & social-sharing preview
  - 1 revision round, delivered in 2 working days after content & 50% advance.
- **Business (₹999 - Most Popular)**:
  - Everything in Starter
  - Up to 12 products & festive offers section
  - Opening hours, shop address & pickup/delivery details
  - Dedicated festive gift box section
  - 2 revision rounds, delivered in 3 working days.
- **Premium (₹1,999)**:
  - Everything in Business
  - Up to 20 products
  - Bilingual Hindi & English content placement
  - Extra visual customisation
  - Connect your own domain
  - 2 revision rounds, delivered in 4 working days.

## Operating Principles & Terms
- **No E-Commerce Cart or Checkout**: Visitors browse products, select items, and hand off to WhatsApp where the merchant handles payment and delivery directly.
- **Hosting**: 90 days of fast static hosting on a provider subdomain included with every package.
- **Payment Structure**: 50% advance to start; balance upon final approval before launch.
- **Honest Disclaimers**: No fake testimonials, no false SEO or revenue guarantees.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Is this an online store?**: It is a product showcase and enquiry page. Customers browse offers, then contact you on WhatsApp. You confirm availability, delivery and payment directly. There is no cart or online checkout.
- **Can I use Hindi and English?**: Yes. We place your supplied content in either language. Premium includes both Hindi and English placement.
- **What do I need to send?**: Business name, logo (if available), product photos, product names and prices, festive offers, WhatsApp number, and hours or pickup/delivery details.
- **What happens after Diwali?**: Package includes 90 days of hosting. You can renew, update for a new festive season, or request static site files.
- **Do you guarantee enquiries or sales?**: No. We provide a polished, high-performance page you can share with pride. Results depend on your offers and customer reach.
